quest.title: "Brave Northerly Wind"
quest.description: In the Forest of Blessings lives a particularly passionate flying squirrel...

dialogues.speaker: Clanche
dialogues.text: Ah, two more brave warriors step up to the plate! Are you here to play Boreal Flurry?

dialogues.speaker: Clanche
dialogues.text: Come then, right this way! I'm looking forward to witnessing your unmatched powers of flight!

response.speaker: Clanche
response.text: One needn't keep cool to fly, dear guest, not at all!

response.speaker: Clanche
response.text: A cool head will merely dull your sense of the wind — only one who faces the wild wind utterly unprepared may uncover their true potential.

response.speaker: Clanche
response.text: Flying squirrels nowadays are far too timid! They've utterly forgotten the lessons taught by the "Brave Northerly Wind"!

response.speaker: Clanche
response.text: They stand in safe spots and declaim the courage of leaves that dance in the wind, yet are far too frightened to leap into its embrace themselves.

response.speaker: Clanche
response.text: How can we protect the kingdom alongside Her Highness if things keep going this way? Ludicrous! Ludicrous, I say!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Man, this flying squirrel sure is the energetic type...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Looks like he really loves flying.

response.speaker: Clanche
response.text: And that's why I found myself a passage with especially intense wind currents, and set up all sorts of devices inside it.

response.speaker: Clanche
response.text: Only the bravest, the boldest, and the most bellicose in flight shall best its course.

response.speaker: Clanche
response.text: Do you have the required courage, dear guests?

choices.text: I'll have a right go at it!

response.speaker: Clanche
response.text: Excellent! Follow me, then! The passage is not far from here!

choices.text: Well... I've got other things to do...

response.speaker: Clanche
response.text: Oh? Still need some time to prepare, then? Fret not, I shall wait here.

response.speaker: Clanche
response.text: Come back whenever you'd like to brave this windy passage.
